headline: Singapore Factory Activity Grows at Slower Pace in October
summary: Singapore's factory activity grew at a slower pace in October following continuous acceleration since March, though analysts expect AI demand to support exports.
why: Singapore serves as a key trade and manufacturing hub for Southeast Asia, making its industrial figures an indicator for regional export health.

impacts.name: Singapore
impacts.why: Factory activity growth moderated in October.
